subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin, the least magically inclined member of the party, correctly identified the psychic center of the Hall of Melting Mirrors using a lucky roll and dwarvish intuition, succeeding where all spellcasters failed.
source_quote: Chipgrin remarked he should have asked the dwarf first, before awkwardly clarifying to Zalthir that he meant no offense by calling them a 'surface dweller'.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar used a mysterious bone die, won from a blind Duergar in Gracklstugh, to pacify an entire army of oozes by channeling Glabbagool into a unifying consciousness, revealing the die's truth-binding nature.
source_quote: The old mule swore it was carved from the knucklebone of a saint who never told a lie, said it had a memory for the truth. I thought he was just trying to cover his losses.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir used a special ability to inspect Jimjar and discovered he possesses divine-level immunities and resistances — immune to poison, psychic damage, charm, fear, radiant energy, and mundane weapons — a profile matching no ordinary gnome and strongly resembling an angel or deity.
source_quote: Jimjar noticed the scrutiny, offered a knowing wink, and vanished entirely from existence, leaving only the faint metallic clink of platinum coins echoing in the tunnel behind him.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar warned the party that Zuggtmoy, unlike Juiblex, prefers to move in while you're sleeping, subtly indicating the true threat is insidious, patient, and already present.
source_quote: Juiblex was a loud, messy neighbor, but this sister, she prefers to move in while you're sleeping.

subject: bone die
fact: The bone die, carved from the knucklebone of a saint who never told a lie, possesses a memory for the truth and was used to temporarily unify all oozes in the cavern through Glabbagool, forcing peace before becoming spent and inert.
source_quote: Jimjar handed it to the party as a keepsake. Grygum paid the ten platinum pieces without complaint, and the party quietly agreed it had been the best investment they had ever made.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool, the party's intelligent gelatinous cube companion, was temporarily transformed by the bone die into a vast, unifying consciousness that connected all oozes, jellies, and puddings in the cavern, speaking gently to them and persuading them to retreat peacefully.
source_quote: He told them, in his gentle and earnest way, that the world was fine, that everyone could get along, and that there was really no need to kill anyone.

subject: Zuggtmoy
fact: Zuggtmoy's influence is subtly present in the chamber, manifesting as fungi and mushrooms growing unnaturally fast — a quiet, creeping threat that moves in while the party sleeps, contrasting with Juiblex's overt chaos.
source_quote: Jimjar pointed to a pale white puffball mushroom growing at impossible speed from a crack in the wall, its scent cloyingly sweet, like a feast left to rot in a hothouse.

subject: Blingdenstone peace accord
fact: The Ember Vanguard brokered a fragile but genuine peace among Blingdenstone's factions — miners, wererats, ghosts, and spiritual leaders — by resolving wage disputes, assigning defense roles to the Gold Whisker wererats, and compromising on sacred mining practices.
source_quote: One by one, the arguments quieted, hands were shaken, and a fragile but genuine peace began to take shape.

subject: Voucher of the Varmint
fact: Chief Chipgrin presented Daz with the Voucher of the Varmint — a braided rat's foot token recognized by wererats and outcasts from Blingdenstone to Menzoberranzan — symbolizing the party's alliance with the underground's hidden networks.
source_quote: Chief Chipgrin pressed a braided rat's foot into Daz's hand — the Voucher of the Varmint, he called it, a token recognized by wererats and outcasts from Blingdenstone all the way to Menzoberranzan.

subject: Jimjar's true nature
fact: Jimjar's divine immunities, vanishing act, and possession of the truth-binding die confirm he is not a gnome but a being of celestial or divine origin — his departure leaves open the possibility of future encounters.
source_quote: Jimjar noticed the scrutiny, offered a knowing wink, and vanished entirely from existence, leaving only the faint metallic clink of platinum coins echoing in the tunnel behind him.

subject: Blingdenstone
fact: Blingdenstone has transitioned from a fractured, war-torn city to a fragile but unified community under the Ember Vanguard’s mediation, now sending them off with ceremony and legends of their deeds spreading through the tunnels.
source_quote: Working-class gnomes lined the tunnels chanting their new rallying cry, the Burrow Warden ghosts dipped their spectral banners in salute.
